title: Lithium
description: No-compromises game logic optimization mod, useful for both single-player games and multi-player servers.
body:
Lithium is a modern, general-purpose optimization mod for Minecraft which works to improve a number of systems (game physics, mob AI, block ticking, etc) with the goal of **not changing any vanilla mechanics**.
The mod works **on both the client and server**, and can be installed on servers
